description: The plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU scores and an unspecified variable on the x-axis, comparing four different models: Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE-MP, and Consistency-Bi. The x-axis is labeled but without a specific title, has a linear scale, ranges from 0.0 to 10.0, and has tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU", also has a linear scale, ranges from 18 to 28, and has tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot shows four lines representing the four models: Consistency-CE is represented by a purple dashed line with circle markers, starting at around 18.5 at x=0.0 and increasing to approximately 27 at x=10.0; Inconsistency-CE is depicted by a dark purple dashed line with square markers, beginning at about 19.5 at x=0.0 and rising to around 27 at x=10.0; Inconsistency-CE-MP is shown as a blue dashed line with square markers, starting at roughly 18.5 at x=0.0 and reaching about 27 at x=10.0; Consistency-Bi is represented by a red solid line with star markers, starting at approximately 22 at x=0.0 and increasing to around 28.5 at x=7.5 before slightly decreasing to about 28.25 at x=10.0. All four lines exhibit an overall increasing trend across the x-axis, with Consistency-Bi consistently having higher BLEU scores than the other three models.
